rules: target validation is injected from the owning authority and arbitrary dynamic table lookup is forbidden
global and pack taxonomy nodes have no tenant owner; tenant extension nodes require a tenant semantic namespace
tenant overlays are deltas and never mutate inherited nodes
placement history is append-only except one-way close of the open effective period
effective hierarchy cycles are rejected across both base placements and tenant parent overrides
classification governance is append-only except one-way close of the open effective period
active pack/template sources are composition context, not semantic ownership
